key_findings: Thymoquinone alleviated paclitaxel-induced nociceptive behavior and reduced TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and IL-6 in mice.
TQ acts through TLR4/MyD88 and downstream NF-kB and MAPK pathways; TAK-242 supported TLR4 involvement.
